mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply chain disruption regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing output contraction that increases inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 during supply chain disruption, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235.0, it signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL above 235.0 signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% during high labor market tightness, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
